title: TIDE: Tree-Induced Fine-Grained Diagnostic Evaluation from Model Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2610.29985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Benchmark performance is the dominant standard for comparing large language models (LLMs), typically summarized by a single aggregate score, such as accuracy, pass rate, or rubric score. This aggregate score provides limited information about a model's underlying capabilities, yet understanding these capabilities is crucial for model development and evaluation. To this end, we propose Tree-Induced Diagnostic Evaluation (TIDE), which recasts diagnostic evaluation as behavior-driven decision-tree induction to perform fine-grained capability diagnosis. TIDE recursively builds a hierarchical capability tree from benchmark samples and model scores: at each node, an LLM judge proposes candidate splits and performs sample-to-group classification, and behavior-based information gain selects among them. translated_title: TIDE：基于模型行为的树引导细粒度诊断评估
translated_abstract: 基准测试性能是比较大型语言模型（LLM）的主要标准，通常用一个聚合分数来概括，例如准确率、通过率或评分标准分数。这种聚合分数所提供的关于模型底层能力的信息有限，而理解这些能力对模型开发和评估至关重要。为此，我们提出了树引导诊断评估（TIDE），它将诊断评估重新构建为行为驱动的决策树归纳，以实现细粒度的能力诊断。TIDE 从基准样本和模型分数中递归地构建分层能力树：在每个节点，由一个 LLM 评判器提出候选拆分并执行样本到分组的分类，并依据基于行为的信息增益从中选择最优拆分。我们将 TIDE 应用于五个模型和四个基准测试以验证其有效性，并发现了在聚合分数层面无法观察到的细粒度能力差异。
tldr: TIDE 将诊断评估转化为行为驱动的决策树归纳，通过从基准样本和模型分数中自动构建分层能力树，实现了对大语言模型能力的细粒度诊断，揭示出聚合分数无法反映的能力差异。
en_tdlr: TIDE recasts diagnostic evaluation as behavior-driven decision-tree induction, recursively building a hierarchical capability tree from benchmark samples and model scores to enable fine-grained capability diagnosis of LLMs beyond aggregate benchmark scores.
